# Zero Block Header

A highly customizable, responsive navigation header block for websites and landing pages.

## Properties

- **Brand Logo Text (`logo`)**: Text brand title.
- **Logo Image URL (`logoUrl`)**: URL path for brand image logo.
- **Navigation Links (`linksJson`)**: JSON array string of menu link items: `[{"label": "Home", "href": "#"}, ...]`.
- **CTA Button Label (`ctaText`)**: Main action button label.
- **CTA Redirect Link (`ctaUrl`)**: Destination URL path.
- **Layout Variant (`layout`)**:
  - `layout-1`: Standard (Links Centered, CTA right)
  - `layout-2`: Minimalist (Links Right, No CTA)
  - `layout-3`: Centered Brand Logo (Links & Actions wrapped below)
- **Theme Mode (`themeStyle`)**: `light` / `dark` / `transparent`
